explainer.what: রেট সিদ্ধান্তের সাথে প্রকাশিত নীতি বিবৃতি — অর্থনীতির মূল্যায়ন ও ভবিষ্যৎ নির্দেশনা।
explainer.why: শব্দ বদল (যেমন 'further adjustments') থেকেই বাজার পরবর্তী পদক্ষেপ পড়ে নেয়।
explainer.effect: রেট উঁচু রাখার ভাষা = USD Bullish; রেট কাটের ভাষা = USD Bearish।

ff_specs.Usual Effect: More Bullish than expected is good for currency
ff_specs.Frequency: Scheduled 8 times per year
ff_specs.FF Notes: The FOMC usually changes the statement slightly at each release. It's these changes that traders focus on
ff_specs.Why Traders Care: It's the primary tool the FOMC uses to communicate with investors about monetary policy. It contains the outcome of their vote on interest rates and other policy measures, along with commentary about the economic conditions that influenced their votes. Most importantly, it discusses the economic outlook and offers clues on the outcome of future votes
ff_specs.Also Called: Interest Rate Statement, Fed Statement, Monetary Policy Statement

explainer.publisher: Federal Reserve — Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC)
explainer.why: সব অ্যাসেটের দামের ভিত্তি এই হার। সাধারণত সিদ্ধান্ত আগেই বাজারে দামে থাকে — তাই আসল মুভ আসে সারপ্রাইজ, স্টেটমেন্টের ভাষা, ডট-প্লট ও প্রেস কনফারেন্স থেকে।
explainer.effect: প্রত্যাশার চেয়ে বেশি হাইক/কম কাট = USD Bullish; উল্টোটা হলে USD Bearish।

ff_specs.Measures: Interest rate at which depository institutions lend balances held at the Federal Reserve to other depository institutions overnight
ff_specs.Usual Effect: 'Actual' greater than 'Forecast' is good for currency
ff_specs.Frequency: Scheduled 8 times per year
ff_specs.FF Notes: The rate decision is usually priced into the market, so it tends to be overshadowed by the FOMC Statement, which is focused on the future
ff_specs.Why Traders Care: Short term interest rates are the paramount factor in currency valuation - traders look at most other indicators merely to predict how rates will change in the future
ff_specs.Derived Via: FOMC members vote on where to set the target rate. The individual votes are published in the FOMC statement
